node.size_y (light): number|null; second side/diameter; omitted = size (square/disk)
node.spot_blend (light): number; 0..1; default 0.15
node.spot_size (light): number; full cone angle; default 0.7853982
node.temperature (light): number|null; K; multiplies color; not environment
material.aov.aov: render.aovs name
material.attribute.attribute: string; geometry or instance attribute name; colour values are linear Rec.709 (no sRGB decoding)
material.attribute.channel: r|g|b|a|rgb; omitted: r scalar, rgb colour, exact for vectors
material.attribute.factor: number|vector; omitted = 1
material.channel.channel: color|depth|view_normal|object_index|motion|shadow_catcher; compositor programs
material.double_sided: bool; false culls back faces; default true
material.grid.grid: buffer-name|inline buffer; buffer with a grid
material.inputs: {name: number|vector|bool|enum-token|{image}|{attribute}|{grid}|{aov}|{node}|{channel}}; default {}

material.inputs (std/openpbr): OpenPBR Surface; shaded inputs: base_weight base_color base_metalness specular_weight specular_color specular_roughness specular_roughness_anisotropy specular_ior transmission_weight transmission_color transmission_depth subsurface_weight subsurface_color subsurface_radius subsurface_radius_scale subsurface_scatter_anisotropy coat_weight coat_color coat_roughness coat_ior coat_darkening fuzz_weight fuzz_color fuzz_roughness emission_luminance emission_color thin_film_weight thin_film_thickness thin_film_ior geometry_opacity geometry_thin_walled geometry_normal geometry_tangent geometry_coat_normal transmission_dispersion_scale transmission_dispersion_abbe_number alpha_cutoff

material.inputs.alpha_cutoff: number; Negative disables threshold; otherwise geometry_opacity >= alpha_cutoff produces 1, else 0; range [-1,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture; animatable; default -1

material.inputs.base_color: color3; Base reflection albedo (dielectric); F0 colour at normal incidence (metal); range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
material.inputs.base_metalness: number; Fraction of the microsurface that is metallic; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0
material.inputs.base_weight: number; Scalar multiplier to `base_color`; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 1
material.inputs.coat_color: color3; Square of the coat's normal-incidence transmittance; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (1, 1, 1)
material.inputs.coat_darkening: number; Modulates the physical coat darkening effect; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 1
material.inputs.coat_ior: number; Refractive index of the coat; range (0,inf) per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 1.6
material.inputs.coat_roughness: number; Roughness of the coat NDF; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0
material.inputs.coat_weight: number; Coverage weight of the coat slab; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0

material.inputs.emission_color: color3; Emission colour multiplier (emitted = `emission_color` × `emission_luminance`); range [0,inf) per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (1, 1, 1)

material.inputs.emission_luminance: number; Emission luminance with `emission_color` = (1,1,1), before coat and fuzz; range [0,inf) per channel; units cd/m² (nits); constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0
material.inputs.fuzz_color: color3; Reflection albedo colour of the fuzz; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (1, 1, 1)
material.inputs.fuzz_roughness: number; Reflection roughness of the fuzz; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0.5
material.inputs.fuzz_weight: number; Coverage weight of the fuzz slab; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0

material.inputs.geometry_coat_normal: vector3; Shading normal of the coat; linear tangent-space RGB; factor scales XY; independent of base normal; range N/A; units dimensionless; constant or texture; animatable; default unperturbed normal
material.inputs.geometry_normal: vector3; Shading normal of the base; range N/A; units dimensionless; constant or texture; animatable; default unperturbed normal
material.inputs.geometry_opacity: number; Opacity (presence) of the surface; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture; animatable; default 1
material.inputs.geometry_tangent: vector3; Reference tangent for specular anisotropy; range N/A; units dimensionless; constant or texture; animatable; default unperturbed tangent
material.inputs.geometry_thin_walled: bool; Surface is a thin shell with no interior volume; range {false,true}; units dimensionless; constant only; not animatable; default false

material.inputs.specular_color: color3; Tints the dielectric Fresnel factor; metal colour at near-grazing incidence; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (1, 1, 1)
material.inputs.specular_ior: number; Refractive index of the base dielectric; range (0,inf) per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 1.5

material.inputs.specular_roughness: number; Roughness of the NDF of the dielectric BSDF and conductor BRDF; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0.3

material.inputs.specular_roughness_anisotropy: number; Anisotropy of that NDF (stretch along `geometry_tangent`); range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0

material.inputs.specular_weight: number; Modulates the dielectric reflectivity at normal incidence (via IOR); overall multiplier of the metallic Fresnel; range [0,inf) per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 1

material.inputs.subsurface_color: color3; Observed reflection colour of the subsurface medium; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
material.inputs.subsurface_radius: number; Length scale of the mean free path; range [0,inf) per channel; units metres; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 1

material.inputs.subsurface_radius_scale: color3; RGB multiplier to `subsurface_radius` (per-channel MFP); range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (1.0, 0.5, 0.25)

material.inputs.subsurface_scatter_anisotropy: number; Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy of the subsurface medium; range [-1,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0
material.inputs.subsurface_weight: number; Mix weight between subsurface and diffuse slabs; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0
material.inputs.thin_film_ior: number; Refractive index of the film; range (0,inf) per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 1.4
material.inputs.thin_film_thickness: number; Thickness of the film in micrometres; range [0,inf) per channel; units µm; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0.5
material.inputs.thin_film_weight: number; Coverage weight of the thin film; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0

material.inputs.transmission_color: color3; Transmission colour; sets the extinction of the interior medium; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default (1, 1, 1)

material.inputs.transmission_depth: number; Depth at which `transmission_color` is realised; 0 = constant on-surface tint; range [0,inf) per channel; units metres; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0

material.inputs.transmission_dispersion_abbe_number: number; Physical Abbe number of the base dielectric medium; range (0,inf) per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 20
material.inputs.transmission_dispersion_scale: number; Linearly scales the amount of dispersion; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0
material.inputs.transmission_weight: number; Mix weight between translucent base and opaque base slabs; range [0,1] per channel; units dimensionless; constant|texture|attribute; animatable; default 0
material.node.node: earlier compositor entry name; clamped bilinear image sampling

material.opacity: coverage|transmittance|null; null = coverage, transmittance for transmitting surfaces; coverage = occupied area fraction; transmittance = continuous attenuation by 1 - geometry_opacity; renderer chooses integration; default null
material.program: program-name|inline program|<library>/<module>; std/openpbr, std/hair (curves only), or custom; default std/openpbr
material.texture.image: image-name|inline image; the program owns sampling and UV transforms
node.file (asset): file-path
node.materials (asset): {imported-name|#index|*: material-name|inline material}; #index = glTF material index; specific beats *; default {}
node.nodes (asset): {imported-name|#index: overrides}; #index = glTF node index; default {}
node.nodes.<name>.light_link_tags (asset): string[]|null; replaces inherited tags
node.nodes.<name>.pass_index (asset): u32|null; 1..65535; object ID
node.children: node[]; default []
node.is_holdout: bool; RGB 0; alpha 0 on transparent background, 1 on opaque background; default false

node.is_shadow_catcher: bool; shadow_catcher channel is material light with CG / without CG, unclamped; zero baseline gives neutral 1; CG light on an otherwise unlit catcher cannot be represented; default false
node.light_link_tags: string[]; matched by light illuminates/shadowed_by; inherited; default []
node.geometry (mesh): geometry-name|inline geometry
node.instances (mesh): instances|null

node.instances.attributes (mesh): equal-length buffers: TRANSLATION vec3, ROTATION vec4 (xyzw), SCALE vec3 (omitted = identity; any zero world-scale component hides the instance), time_offset f32, pass_index u32, custom columns bind to material inputs
node.instances.count (mesh): one-element u32 compute buffer; zero to attribute capacity; overflow rejects the exposure
node.materials (mesh): (material-name|inline material)[]; empty = default std/openpbr with roughness 0.5; default []
node.morph_weights (mesh): {name:number}; default {}
node.skin (mesh): skin|null
node.skin.inverse_bind_matrices (mesh): mat4-buffer-name|inline buffer
node.skin.joints (mesh): node-name[]
node.name: string; globally unique, including imported nodes; default ""
node.pass_index: u32|null; 1..65535; object ID
node.rotation: [x,y,z,w] quaternion | {euler:[x,y,z]} (Blender XYZ); default [0,0,0,1]
node.scale: [x,y,z]; any zero world-scale component hides geometry, including children; default [1,1,1]
node.target: node-name|[x,y,z]|null; aims -Z, world Y up; rotation is an offset on top
node.translation: [x,y,z]; parent frame; default [0,0,0]
node.visible: bool; false hides the subtree and disables its lights; animatable (step); default true
node.visible_camera: bool; default true
node.visible_diffuse: bool; default true
node.visible_glossy: bool; default true
node.visible_shadow: bool; lights must stay true (a light without shadows: shadowed_by []); default true
node.visible_transmission: bool; object visibility to transmission rays; lights must stay true; default true
profile.description: string; default ""
profile.level: u8; 0..3; quality/cost level; 3 is previs
profile.settings: Settings; seed, samples and denoise only; default {}
profile.version: u32

program.bindings: <binding>_load(i), _store(i,v), _count; dense grids also expose _dims; u32 _atomic_min(i,v) returns prior value (OOB: UINT_MAX); mat4 = VorkMat4 {c0..c3 columns}; out-of-range loads 0, stores ignored; default {}
program.dispatch: item count or [x,y,z] threads; install/init dt=0; frame schedule frame 0 dt=0; simulation ticks use fixed dt
program.file: file-path; XOR source; Slang module, import vork
program.schedule: install|frame|simulation; frame uses output FPS; simulation uses scene.simulation pass order; each material instance dispatches with its inputs
program.source: Slang source; XOR file; import vork
program.source_origin: virtual filename|null; inline source only; resolves local imports
render.aovs: [{name,type:value|color}]; output with --channels all or aov:<name>; default []
render.aovs.name: name; EXR channels <name>.X or <name>.R/G/B
render.aovs.type: value|color
render.background: environment|transparent|RGB; RGB and transparent apply to camera escapes and opacity passthrough; path glass transmission sees the World; default environment
render.camera: camera-node-name|null; null = the only authored camera, else first imported; a camera cut track may select; default null
render.compositor: (material-name|{material,name?,resolution?})[]; ordered image graph, last output; material may be inline; default []
render.display: material-name|inline material; display program; EXR stays scene-linear; default {"program":"std/agx"}
render.duration: number; default 10.416667
render.fps: number; default 24
render.motion_blur: MotionBlur|null; non-null enables; shutter in frames; default null
render.motion_blur.position: start|center|end; default center
render.motion_blur.shutter: number; frames; default 0.5
render.resolution: uvec2; default [1920,1080]
render.root: node-name|null; only this subtree draws and is lit; objects outside still cast shadows; null = whole scene; default null
scene.animation: layer[]; default []
scene.buffers: {name:buffer}; default {}
scene.geometry: {name:geometry}; default {}
scene.images: {name:image}; default {}
scene.materials: {name:material}; default {}
scene.nodes: node[]
scene.programs: {name:program}; default {}
scene.propagation: {program,bounds}|null; authored straight ray segments inside world-space bounds
scene.render: render; default {}
scene.simulation: simulation|null; fixed-clock ordered retained compute
scene.version: 2
settings.denoise: bool; optional OIDN on/off; off retains profile reconstruction; default false
settings.samples: u32; 1..4096; more samples means cleaner and slower
settings.seed: u32; deterministic sampling seed; default 0
simulation.dt: positive finite seconds; fixed tick independent of output FPS; inputs sample left endpoints
simulation.init: program-name[]; ordered initialization passes; schedule simulation
simulation.seed: u32; independent of image sampling seed
simulation.state: buffer-name[]; complete typed persistent and scratch state; exclusive schedule ownership
simulation.steps: program-name[]; ordered tick passes with storage barriers; schedule simulation
simulation.t0: seconds; initialized state S0; requests before t0 hold S0

material.inputs.subsurface: thick: radius × radius_scale; thin: diffuse reflection/transmission split by scatter_anisotropy

node.nodes.<name>.visible_diffuse (asset): bool; default true
node.nodes.<name>.visible_glossy (asset): bool; default true
node.nodes.<name>.visible_transmission (asset): bool; default true
